name: zavudev
description: Official CLI for Zavu — deploy Functions, send messages, manage senders & contacts.

scripts.build:all: bun run build:macos-arm64 && bun run build:macos-x64 && bun run build:linux-x64 && bun run build:linux-arm64 && bun run build:windows-x64
scripts._comment_prepublish: bun build inlines package.json at BUILD time, so `npm publish` shipped whatever dist/ happened to hold. Every release since 0.6.x therefore reported an older --version than it was: the 0.6.2 tarball prints 0.6.0. Rebuilding on prepack makes the binary and the manifest agree by construction rather than by remembering.
